name: Claim Check
office_task: Check every subbie's claim, line by line, against the agreed contract rate before anyone pays it, keep the record, and put any mismatch in front of a named person.
systems_of_record: Xero or MYOB (the ledger that issues the bill_id and holds the subcontract or purchase order with its agreed rates)
the job system (Simpro, ServiceM8 or similar) for the quantity marked complete
the document store where the signed variation approvals live

emits.write: a check note on the subcontractor's bill in the ledger: each of the four checks (rate, quantity, variation, contract sum) with what it compared, the subcontract it was read against and the tolerance in force with its date, and the bill placed in the done-and-reversible list for a named person to approve. Nothing is approved or paid
emits.readback: reading the bill by its bill_id from the ledger (Xero GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{bill_id}/History, or the MYOB bill's journal memo) returns the check note with the four results and seam.queue = done_reversible; no note back means it was not written and the bill is raised as an exception instead

emits.write: an exception on the bill naming the person who owns it: the first check that failed and the checks that never ran, the difference in dollars, the cumulative position, the claim document, and its queue (needs a decision; waiting on the subbie for a missing claim document; or blocked: no subcontract named, or scope with no written approval)
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the bill_id, the failed check, the dollar difference, the source document and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

port_of.original_name: Check invoice contract price compliance with Google Sheets and Telegram alerts
